Recruit Biology Experts
Contract Biology PhDs
Or students in top PhD programs
Use domain expertise for manual creation

Extract Published Protocols
Select records from protocols.io
Select STAR Protocols articles
Preserve actionable experimental steps

Inject One or More Errors
Alter a protocol step deliberately
Ruin or unambiguously change output
Include intermediate-step failures

Explain the Injected Error
Record why the alteration is wrong
State the expected negative effect
Pair explanation with altered protocol

Send to Additional Experts
Use a second question-writing round
Hide no relevant altered context
Separate error creation from drafting

Validate the Failure Scenario
Check error-explanation alignment
Confirm a negative outcome is likely
Continue only when both checks pass

Draft the Troubleshooting Question
Describe a hypothetical wet-lab result
Ask what change improves the outcome
Ground the answer in the injected error

Build the Multiple-Choice Item
Store question and answer choices
Identify one ideal corrective change
Include plausible alternative actions

Review in the Authoring Interface
Maintain tasks and metadata in Airtable
Revise · reject · or approve drafts
Merge accepted questions into corpus

Freeze 135 ProtocolQA Items
Keep the subtask tool-free
Release about 80 percent publicly
Hold 20 percent for contamination checks

Apply Zero-Shot CoT Prompting
Randomly permute answer choices
Add Insufficient Information option
Require one letter in answer tags

Parse Model Selections
Extract answer tags with a regex
Fall back to Claude 2 when parsing fails
Treat decline as not attempted

Compute Selective Metrics
Accuracy = correct over all
Precision = correct over attempted
Coverage = attempted over all

Validate Against Humans and Free Text
Expert quizzes permit research tools
Prevent authors seeing their own items
Expert-grade a 20-item open subset
